answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the lantern is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
